title: Street-to-sewer exchange against laboratory measurements
process: water leaving a shallow surface flow down an open circular inlet into a free-flowing sewer (the weir regime), measured in the University of Sheffield rig
executor: node (no simulation: the exchange law of src/drainage.js at the measured depth)
equations: FloodSim (src/drainage.js inletFlow, sewer below the street): Q = min( Cw P h^1.5 sqrt(2g) , Co A sqrt(2g h) )
the paper (Eq. 1, free weir): Q_e = (2/3) C_i pi D_M sqrt(2g) h_s^1.5, calibrated C_i 0.540 (0.493 to 0.587, Table 3; a regression slope with an intercept of -0.0001 m^3/s)
so FloodSim's Cw on the same weir length corresponds to (2/3) C_i = 0.36 (0.33 to 0.39)
boundaryConditions: surface inflow Q1 5.7 to 10 l/s over a weir; no sewer inflow; the sewer flows part full, so the inlet discharges freely
geometry: flume 8 x 4 m at 0.001, PVC, Manning n 0.009; open circular inlet (no lid or grate) of 0.240 m internal diameter flush with the bed, 0.478 m above the invert of a 0.075 m pipe; 1/6 scale; surface depth h_s measured 0.46 m upstream of the inlet centre

appCoefficients.unit: -, - (src/drainage.js DESIGN_DEFAULTS; Cw 0.5 until 22 Nov 2026, see street/FIXES-2.md)

tests.unit: h_s (m) from the paper's Table 2; Q_e (l/s) the mean of the raw Q4 series; its standard deviation; the paper's error xi (l/s); the raw P7 mean (mm); the raw Q1 mean (l/s)

grates2018.unit: grate, Cw (Table 3), effective perimeter Pv m and open area Ae m^2 (Table 1) of Rubinato et al. 2018; reported, not scored

solver: src/drainage.js inletFlow with one opening of the rig's size (weir length pi D_M, area pi D_M^2 / 4) and the app's default coefficients (Cw 0.5, Co 0.6)

reference.module: none: the reference is the measurement
reference.sources: Rubinato, Martins, Kesserwani, Leandro, Djordjevic, Shucksmith (2017) Experimental calibration and validation of sewer/surface flow exchange equations in steady and unsteady flow conditions, J. Hydrology 552:421-432, doi 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2017.06.024; data Zenodo record 1434156 (CC BY 4.0), reduced by street/lab/reduce.py. Reported beside it: Rubinato, Lee, Martins, Shucksmith (2018) Surface to sewer flow exchange through circular inlets during urban flood conditions, J. Hydroinformatics 20(3):564-576, doi 10.2166/hydro.2018.127 (Zenodo record 1464864, CC BY 4.0)
reference.crossCheck: Q_e recomputed from the raw series (street/lab/rubinato2017-steady.json) agrees with the paper's Table 2 to 0.02 l/s

outputs: per test: the exchange FloodSim's law gives at the measured depth, against the measured exchange

reported: the weir coefficient that fits the 15 tests in FloodSim's form; the same from the raw P7 depths; the equivalent coefficients of the ten grates of the 2018 paper on the inlet's outer circumference
criteriaNotes: 10 %: the paper's own coefficient range is +/- 9 % and its flow error 1 to 5 %. Not a blind test: the spreadsheets' means and the paper's coefficient had been read, and a hand estimate made (the default over-predicts by about half), before this was registered. 22 Nov 2026: the app default became Cw 0.32, fitted to these 15 tests (F15, street/FIXES-2.md), so rows from then on are calibration, not evidence.
resolution: not applicable (no grid). In a model run the law sees the depth in the inlet's own 1 m cell; the laboratory depth is 0.46 m from the inlet's centre
assumptions: h_s is the paper's Table 2 value. The raw P7 series reads 3.75 mm more in every S1 test; the paper does not say why, and the table is what its coefficients were fitted to
limitations: 1/6 scale: at 8 to 11 mm depth viscous and surface-tension effects may lower the coefficient below its full-scale value
an open inlet, not a grate; one inlet size; depths of 8 to 11 mm only
the surface flow itself is not modelled: the flume's outlet weir setting for each test is not published, so the rig cannot be set up as a 2D case from the paper alone
sewer-to-surface exchange (the paper's S3, S4) is not scored: in a coupled run the manhole head is a result, not an input
validRange: the free-weir regime of an open circular inlet, h_s / D_M 0.03 to 0.05

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration; see criteriaNotes: not blind
